subject: Insurance
title: Electric Vehicle Insurance Challenges
description: A short lesson to help you apply Electric Vehicle Insurance Challenges.

hook.text: EVs cost 15-25% more to insure than gas equivalents.

buildup.text: EV batteries are built into the floor.

discovery.text: Repair shops need specialized EV training and equipment.

twist.text: Tesla launched its own insurance company.

climax.text: EVs are changing auto insurance from the ground up: new risks, new repair costs, and new data.

quiz.question: Why do EVs cost more to insure?
options: Expensive battery replacement and specialized repairs
